title: Quiz: Common Table Expressions
description: Check your understanding of Common Table Expressions.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in SQL?
questions.explanation: In SQL, -- marks a comment. Block comments use /* */.

questions.question: What is the main readability benefit of a CTE?
questions.correctAnswer: Naming a subquery as a reusable "virtual table"

questions.question: True or False: CTEs document intent — each step gets a name.
What is the main purpose of the Common Table Expressions technique shown in this lesson?
questions.explanation: It exists to help you common table expressions effectively.

questions.question: In SQL, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
